Package gov.cdc.izgateway.utils

Class X500Utils

java.lang.Object
gov.cdc.izgateway.utils.X500Utils
public class X500Utils extends Object
A collection of static methods to operate on X500 names (commonNames in certificates). This class is used to extract just the Common Name or the Organization from a X509 Certificate.
